title: Le sol
through_line: Une main qui gratte la terre, et quatre sols qui défilent sous nos yeux.

blocks.vo_line: Le sol est la partie du dessus de la terre.
blocks.shot: A gentle cut-away of the ground, the thin top layer highlighted, grass and a small plant growing on it.

blocks.vo_line: Tous les sols ne sont pas pareils.
blocks.shot: Four small open jars of earth of clearly different colours lined up on a wooden table.

blocks.vo_line: Le sol sablonneux est fait de grains de roche.
blocks.shot: A close wide view of pale sandy soil with visible grains running through open fingers.

blocks.vo_line: Le sol ferralitique est rouge : il est riche en fer.
blocks.shot: A close wide view of bright red laterite earth, clearly red and rust coloured, a dark iron pebble on it.

blocks.vo_line: Le sol basaltique est noir, et les plantes y poussent bien.
blocks.shot: A close wide view of dark black earth with several healthy green sprouts growing out of it.

blocks.vo_line: Le sol argileux est mou, et il n’est pas fertile.
blocks.shot: A close wide view of soft grey clay earth, cracked and bare, a finger print pressed into it, no plant.
